notes: First worker goes sheep til 7 workers@unit_worker/villager.webp@ ->@resource/sheep.png@
3 Next workers rally to gold, build House@building_economy/house.webp@ and Quary@building_economy/mining-camp.png@
Rally workers on @resource/sheep.webp@ til 200 gold to age up. Age from sheep workers @unit_worker/villager.png@ X5 --->@landmark_english/council-hall.png@

@landmark_english/council-hall.webp@ Workers from age up goes to @unit_worker/villager.png@ -> @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@ wood. Build extra house.@building_economy/house.png@. First 100 extra wood builds tower at gold @building_defensive/outpost.png@

Villager split should be 5 on wood, for first  @building_military/barracks.webp@, then rest of the wood goes for @building_economy/farm.png@. Barracks is used to counter horsemen aggression, 2-5 spearmen at gold location.

1200 food and 600 gold is our target to age up. @landmark_english/kings-palace.webp@ Kings Palace in team games for extra villagers, or if aggressive team game go for @landmark_english/the-white-tower.png@ White tower to build early knights or Men at arms

When going to Castle age, prio is to get all Eco upgrades and more focus on gold. @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@--> @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.png@->@technology_economy/lumber-preservation.png@->@technology_economy/horticulture.png@->@technology_economy/fertilization.png@->@technology_economy/specialized-pick.png@->@technology_economy/acid-distilization.png@ | 12 @unit_worker/villager.png@ on gold is enough to produce @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.png@x3 @unit_english/longbowman-2.png@x2 @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.png@x2.
